findings.title: Corrupt delivery state loosens Agency milestone binding
findings.detail: When delivery.json is corrupt, its default DeliveryState has no active milestone and the Agency fallback is deliberately restricted to report.state == missing; active_milestone therefore remains empty and matching is skipped, so same-HEAD unscoped evidence can satisfy Agency signoff despite a persisted current_milestone.
findings.suggestion: For active Agency signoff, preserve a binding to the persisted Agency current_milestone (or fail closed) whenever delivery state cannot supply a trustworthy active milestone, including corrupt/read-error cases; add a corrupt-delivery regression test.
